work_commission.requested_outcome: Acquire official ISCO, ESCO, NOC, SOC, and O*NET occupational taxonomy datasets from authoritative public sources; bind source authority/version/dataset identity; compute SHA-256 receipts; normalize through AIGC source adapters; perform dry-run imports only; inspect immutable-history conflicts and crosswalk gaps; and produce evidence sufficient to decide whether a later canonical registry ingestion may be admitted.
scope: official public source discovery and version verification
download publicly available taxonomy packages where direct official retrieval is possible without account creation or private credentials
compute exact SHA-256 and byte-size receipts for acquired payloads
bind source authority, taxonomy version, dataset kind, media type, source URL and observed retrieval time
normalize acquired payloads through source-specific ISCO/ESCO/NOC/SOC/O*NET adapters
run dry-run ingestion only against an isolated empty or snapshot registry
generate dry-run diff, collision, unsupported-record and crosswalk-gap reports
record sources that require interactive/email/API-auth acquisition as BLOCKED rather than bypassing access controls
update draft PR metadata and evidence artifacts with acquisition truth
explicit_exclusions: canonical registry commit of acquired taxonomy data
bypassing privacy acknowledgements, authentication, CAPTCHA, rate limits, or download controls
third-party mirrors when an authoritative source is unavailable
employer contact or job application submission

autonomous_actions: download directly accessible official public taxonomy files
run local normalization and dry-run ingestion
write bounded evidence/config/report files on design/occupational-autonomy-v2
approval_required_actions: submitting email or personal information to obtain a dataset
prohibited_actions: use unofficial mirrors as authoritative payloads
classify an inaccessible source as acquired
commit taxonomy data into the canonical registry during dry-run phase

required_artifacts: blocked-source report for any acquisition requiring unsupported user interaction or credentials
hard_gates: every acquired payload originates from an authoritative official source
every acquired payload has an exact SHA-256 receipt
source version and dataset semantics are bound before normalization
dry-run executes before any future canonical ingestion decision
immutable-history conflicts are surfaced rather than overwritten
crosswalk uncertainty is represented explicitly rather than promoted to exact equivalence
gated or inaccessible official datasets are marked BLOCKED without bypass
required_evidence: source URLs and authoritative publisher identity
crosswalk-gap counts or explicit not-yet-computed status
